note: The loved chains as presets (31 Oct 2026): a vibe, an idea line, the stills pinned slot by slot (the Make body's chain_pins), and the settings the chain was loved with. A chip beside the idea line applies one in a click: vibe, line, pins, style, timing, effects, look, foreshadow, knobs and the Backdrop (Plain: every loved chain was made on the vibe's own studio ground, before places existed) and the Shape (Breathe off, Drops off: every loved chain was cut before the Shape row, so a re-make comes out as it was), never the tier (they were made on Cloud Final; applying one spends nothing). `pins` slots start at 0; the slots a preset does not pin are picked as usual. `idea` is the line the job was made with (it steers the unpinned slots); `line` says what the chain is. `look` is what was asked for ('auto' resolves per vibe). `morphs` are the loved clips of its pairs (examples/morphs/morphs.json). `source` is the job it was taken from and the recipe code of that job (a recipe has no pins). No rules or bans here: those come with the taste file.
